passage.label: This is a reminder and for the righteous a good return; gardens of perpetual residence with doors opened; reclining and calling for abundant fruit and drink; glance-restricting companions of equal age; the promise for the Day of Account; provision without depletion; for the transgressors an evil return, Hell they will burn in, a wretched resting place; scalding water and purulence to taste with other punishments of its kind; a company bursting in unwelcomed and burning; the retort blaming the leaders who brought this upon them; the plea for double punishment on whoever caused it; questioning why the men they counted among the worst are unseen, whether taken in ridicule or missed by their sight; the truth of the quarrelling of the people of the Fire

arabicExcerpts.text: هَٰذَا ذِكۡرٞۚ وَإِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ
مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٖ كَثِيرَةٖ وَشَرَابٖ
إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزۡقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
هَٰذَا فَوۡجٞ مُّقۡتَحِمٞ مَّعَكُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِهِمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ صَالُواْ ٱلنَّارِ
قَالُواْ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِكُمۡۖ أَنتُمۡ قَدَّمۡتُمُوهُ لَنَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ
قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدۡهُ عَذَابٗا ضِعۡفٗا فِي ٱلنَّارِ
وَقَالُواْ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالٗا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَشۡرَارِ
أَتَّخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا أَمۡ زَاغَتۡ عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ
إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقّٞ تَخَاصُمُ أَهۡلِ ٱلنَّارِ

mainSubject.label: Reminder framing the two returns: gardens of perpetual residence with opened doors, reclining ease, abundant fruit and drink, matched-age glance-restricted companions, and inexhaustible provision promised for the Day of Account; against this the transgressors' evil return into Hell with scalding water, purulence and kindred punishments; the incoming company denied welcome and the mutual recrimination between followers and leaders; the plea for doubled punishment on the instigators; the search for those they once mocked and counted among the worst; the whole named as the truth of the Fire-dwellers' quarrelling

notes: Wave 6 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 ends at the punishment-hastening demand (16) before the patience command opens the Dawud block (17); P2 closes with the blessed-Book reflection verse (29); P3 groups the Sulayman, Ayyub and patriarch remembrance sequence (30-48); P4 is the two-returns contrast ending with the Fire quarrel (49-64); P5 begins with the warner-only declaration and runs through the Adam-Iblees narrative to the closing reminder (65-88).
